latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ming: a Chinese traditional metaphysics tool for BaZi, Five Elements, fortune analysis, and name interpretation.

- Provides BaZi (八字) charting and analysis based on birth time.
- Offers Five Elements (五行) distribution, strength/weakness reviews, and practical suggestions.
- Supports annual and 10-year fortune forecasts (career, wealth, relationships, health).
- Includes traditional Chinese name analysis (五格剖象, Five Grid Method).
- Assists in selecting auspicious dates (择日) for important events.
- Analyzes zodiac compatibility and offers pairing suggestions.
- Contains quick reference tables for heavenly stems, earthly branches, and time periods.
- Emphasizes privacy, cultural respect, and entertainment use.
